fusions.name: Roost Breaks
fusions.desc: A burst of air that deals 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocks them back 2.5 tiles. Each has a 30% chance to be turned against its allies for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Sip on the Swoop
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. You swoop on a target up to 5 tiles away and bite, which deals 8 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach, and heals you for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Jinking Flight
fusions.desc: Increases your dodge chance by 25% for 10 seconds and flits you 2 tiles aside.

fusions.name: Night Air Rider
fusions.desc: At night, your dodge chance rises by 12%.
